seo_description: Professional résumé of Samuel Bahago Gabriel, GIS Analyst specializing in remote sensing, hydrology and environmental planning.

hero.heading: Experience that connects
hero.intro: GIS, remote sensing, hydrology and environmental planning for multidisciplinary projects across Nigeria.

profile.text: GIS Analyst and geoscience professional with seven years of experience applying spatial analysis, remote sensing, terrain modelling and hydrologic methods to climate resilience, water resources, infrastructure and environmental-management assignments.

positions.title: GIS Analyst
bullets: Deliver GIS and remote-sensing analysis for water resources, infrastructure, climate-resilience and environmental assignments.
Integrate imagery, DEMs, climate records, field observations and stakeholder data into standardized spatial databases.
Perform watershed, terrain, LULC, flood, erosion and groundwater-potential analysis.
Prepare report-ready maps and support field validation and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

positions.title: Groundwater Site Geologist
bullets: Supported groundwater investigations through geological field observation and interpretation of geospatial and geophysical information.
Prepared site maps and field records for borehole-siting decisions and technical reporting.

positions.title: GIS Analyst
bullets: Produced GIS and remote-sensing outputs for geological, environmental and natural-resource assignments.
Compiled, digitized, georeferenced and analysed datasets and prepared cartographic products for distributed project teams.

items.qualification: Diploma in Project, Quality, Safety, Environment, Risk & Sustainability Management
